title: LiveChatAgentConfig - Metadata API
description: Represents the configuration of an organization’s Chat deployment, such as how many chats can be assigned to an agent and whether chat sounds are enabled.

assignments.description: Specifies how agent configurations are assigned to Chat users. Agent configurations can be assigned to sets of users or sets of profiles.

autoGreeting.description: Specifies the greeting that displays when a customer begins a chat with an agent.

capacity.description: Specifies the maximum number of chats in which an agent can be engaged at a time.

criticalWaitTime.description: Specifies the number of seconds an agent can wait to answer an engaged chat before the chat tab flashes to alert the agent to answer it.

customAgentName.description: Specifies the custom name for an agent, if one has been set. Available in API version 29.0 and later.

disableTransferConferenceGreeting.description: Indicates whether the greeting is disabled for agents during chat transfer and chat conferencing (true) or not (false). Available in API version 53.0 and later.

enableAgentFileTransfer.description: Indicates whether file transfer is enabled for agents (true) or not (false). Available in API version 31.0 and later.

enableAgentSneakPeek.description: Specifies whether a supervisor can see the content of an agent’s message before they send it to a customer (true) or not (false).

enableAssistanceFlag.description: Indicates whether agents can raise an assistance flag to notify a supervisor that they need help. Available in API version 35.0 and later.

enableAutoAwayOnDecline.description: Indicates whether an agent appears as “away” (true) or not (false) when an agent declines a chat with a customer.

enableAutoAwayOnPushTimeout.description: Indicates whether an agent appears as “away” (true) or not (false) when a chat request that's been pushed to the agent times out. Available in API version 34.0 and later.

enableChatConferencing.description: Indicates whether chat conferencing is enabled for agents (true) or not (false). Available in API version 34.0 and later.

enableChatMonitoring.description: Indicates whether chat monitoring is enabled for support supervisors (true) or not (false). Available in API version 29.0 and later.

enableChatTransferToAgent.description: Indicates whether agents can transfer a chat to another agent (true) or not (false). Available in API version 36.0 and later.

enableChatTransferToButton.description: Indicates whether agents can transfer a chat to a button (true) or not (false). Available in API version 36.0 and later.

enableChatTransferToSkill.description: Indicates whether agents can transfer a chat to a skill group (true) or not (false). Available in API version 36.0 and later.

enableLogoutSound.description: Indicates whether a sound plays (true) or not (false) when an agent logs out of Chat.

enableNotifications.description: Indicates whether notifications of incoming chats appear for agents (true) or not (false).

enableRequestSound.description: Indicates whether a sound plays (true) or not (false) when a customer requests to chat with an agent.

enableSneakPeek.description: Indicates whether previews of customers’ messages are displayed as customers type (true) or not (false) in the agent’s Chat window. Available in API version 29.0 and later.

enableVisitorBlocking.description: Indicates whether an agent can block a visitor by IP address (true) or not (false). Available in API version 34.0 and later.

enableWhisperMessage.description: Indicates whether support supervisors can send whisper messages to agents during a chat (true) or not (false). Available in API version 29.0 and later.

label.description: Specifies the name of the configuration for agents’ default chat settings.

supervisorDefaultAgentStatusFilter.description: Specifies the Chat status for filtering the Agent Status list in the Supervisor Panel. Valid values are: Online Away Offline Available in API version 29.0 and later.

supervisorDefaultButtonFilter.description: Specifies the default button for filtering the Agent Status list in the Supervisor Panel. Available in API version 29.0 and later.

supervisorDefaultSkillFilter.description: Specifies the default skill for filtering the Agent Status list in the Supervisor Panel. Available in API version 29.0 and later.

supervisorSkills.description: Specifies the list of agent skills that are assigned to a supervisor, as specified in their assigned Chat configuration. Available in API version 29.0 and later.

transferableButtons.description: Specifies the list of chat buttons that agents can transfer chats to. Available in API version 31.0 and later.

transferableSkills.description: Specifies the list of skill groups that agents can transfer chats to. Available in API version 31.0 and later.

profiles.description: Specifies the profiles that are associated with a specific agent configuration.

users.description: Specifies the users that are associated with a specific agent configuration.

button.description: Specifies the chat buttons that agents can transfer chats to.

profile.description: Specifies the custom name of the profile associated with a specific agent configuration.

skill.description: Specifies the skill groups that agents can transfer chats to.

user.description: Specifies the username of the user associated with a specific agent configuration.

skill.description: Specifies the agent skills available for filtering the Agent Status list in the Supervisor Panel.

declarative_metadata_sample_definition.description: This is a sample of a liveChatAgentConfig file.
declarative_metadata_sample_definition.code:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<LiveChatAgentConfig xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <label>My Agent Configuration 1</label>
    <autoGreeting>Hi, how can I help you?</autoGreeting>
    <capacity>5</capacity>
    <enableAutoAwayOnDecline>true</enableAutoAwayOnDecline>
    <enableLogoutSound>true</enableLogoutSound>
    <enableNotifications>true</enableNotifications>
    <enableRequestSound>true</enableRequestSound>
    <enableSneakPeek>true</enableSneakPeek>
    <enableWhisperMessage>true</enableWhisperMessage>
    <assignments>
        <profiles>
            <profile>standard</profile>
        </profiles>
        <users>
            <user>jdoe@acme.com</user>
        </users>
    </assignments>
</LiveChatAgentConfig>
